strings.title: Restaurant menu on a phone
strings.say_intro: Tonight, someone picks a place to eat from the sofa, on a phone. The menu has small print, prices, allergens. Let's review a real food delivery site the way that phone sees it.
strings.say_run: Let's run it. www.rappi.com.co: 20 pages, six areas. SEO, AI search, analytics, security, accessibility and speed.
strings.say_score: 69 out of 100. Grade D. 5 checks fail, 20 are at risk, and 21 pass.
